convert_swin_pth_to_d2_pkl: run the script to convert a Swin Transformer pretrained .pth model to a Detectron2-compatible .pkl file
run_model_conversion_cli: run the conversion script with an input .pth path and output .pkl path as command-line arguments
load_swin_model_weights: load a Swin Transformer pretrained model from a .pth file using torch.load with cpu mapping
create_d2_weight_dict: create a Detectron2 weight dictionary with model state dict, author, and matching heuristics flags
pickle_model_for_d2: pickle the converted model weights into a .pkl file for use with Detectron2 configuration
